description: This file defines the ApplyTokenParser class which is responsible for parsing 'apply' tags in Twig templates, applying filters over sections of the template.

classes.name: Twig	okenparser\ApplyTokenParser
classes.description: An internal class that parses the custom 'apply' tag in Twig templates, allowing filters to be applied to sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'apply' tag in the Twig template and returns the corresponding Node structure.

methods.name: decideApplyEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of the 'apply' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'apply' that this parser handles.
